cues: In nineteen twenty four, Spemann and Mangold grafted a dorsal lip from one newt embryo onto the belly of another.
The host grew a complete second embryo.
The dorsal lip is the primary organiser.
And one fact students get backwards: in the frog, the blastopore becomes the anus, not the mouth.
text: In nineteen twenty four, Spemann and Mangold grafted a dorsal lip from one newt embryo onto the belly of another. The host grew a complete second embryo. The dorsal lip is the primary organiser. And one fact students get backwards: in the frog, the blastopore becomes the anus, not the mouth. Frogs, like us, are deuterostomes.
